notice: Pinned digest test vectors for heretek-rigs (HR-3.3). These vectors pin the UTF-16 code-unit sort order, the JCS-shaped canonical form, and the package-digest coverage string that scripts/generate-rigs.py and scripts/verify-rigs.sh must agree on. scripts/verify-rigs.sh replays every vector and fails closed on mismatch.

utf16_configuration_id.description: configurationId joins k=v pairs sorted by UTF-16 code units (A=65 < a=97 < b=98).

jcs_canonical_form.description: Canonical JSON of {b:2,a:1} under sort_keys + compact separators (RFC 8785 shape for float-free bodies).

package_digest_coverage.description: Coverage string every packageDigest must carry.

package_digest_algorithm.description: Hash algorithm every packageDigest must use.
